constraints.message: HS oscillator: High speed crystal/resonator on GP4/OSC2/CLKOUT and GP5/OSC1/CLKIN: the external frequency must be 4 MHz or more.
XT oscillator: Crystal/resonator on GP4/OSC2/CLKOUT and GP5/OSC1/CLKIN: the external frequency must be 0.1-4 MHz.
